nom: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)

imtihonlar.qiymat: A level/IB yoki teng malaka; noan'anaviy yoki kam tanilgan malakalar bilan topshirganlardan LSE'ning Undergraduate Admissions Assessment (UGAA) talab qilinishi mumkin; ingliz tili: IELTS Academic yoki teng
imtihonlar.manba_iborasi: may be required to sit the Undergraduate Admissions Assessment (UGAA) as part of their application to LSE.

xalqaro_yordam_turi.qiymat: Overseas talabalarga ehtiyojga asoslangan Undergraduate Support Scheme (odatda yiliga 15 000–25 000 GBP; hammaga yetmaydi) va xayriya stipendiyalari
xalqaro_yordam_turi.manba_iborasi: The LSE Undergraduate Support Scheme provides funding for Overseas fee status students who do not have the necessary funds to meet all their costs of study.

deadline.manba_iborasi: The last date for the receipt of applications to LSE to qualify for full and equal consideration is 13 January 2027, 18.00 (GMT).

foundation_kerak.manba_iborasi: The Certificate of Completed Secondary Education isn't acceptable as an entry qualification for LSE.
